title: Lost Mary BM600 Strawberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these replacement pods allow you to continue enjoying the same effortless vaping experience without replacing your entire device. Each pack contains two prefilled 2ml disposable pods with 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. With each pod delivering up to 600 puffs (depending on personal usage and vaping style), these convenient replacements offer an easy way to keep your device topped up with your favourite Lost Mary flavours. Simply remove the old pod, click in a new one, and enjoy a consistently satisfying vape. The Strawberry Ice flavour captures the lush sweetness of sun-ripened strawberries, enhanced by a refreshing menthol chill. The balance of juicy berry notes and an icy exhale creates a smooth, crisp, and uplifting vape that lingers on the tastebuds. Perfect for vapers who love fruit flavours with a frosty finish, the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods provide a convenient and cost-effective way to experience the signature Lost Mary BM600 range.
